queries: SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count, COUNT(t.telescregistry) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share_of_all_telescopes FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation ORDER BY share_of_all_telescopes DESC, o.observstation ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share_of_all_telescopes FROM telescopes AS t GROUP BY t.observstation ORDER BY share_of_all_telescopes DESC, t.observstation ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share_of_all_telescopes FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation ORDER BY share_of_all_telescopes DESC, observstation LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS telescope_share FROM telescopes AS t GROUP BY t.observstation ORDER BY telescope_share DESC, t.observstation LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Stations with no telescopes are eligible for the top 10 and have a share of zero when telescopes exist.

alternatives.interpretation: Rank only stations that have at least one telescope.
